notes.title: Anomaly 13 Page released
notes.content:
Wizard Games here!  
Thank you all for following us! We're excited to announce that the Steam page for our new game, Anomaly 13, is now live! 🎉  
Make sure to add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Patch 0.6.4a
notes.content:
- Added a player in the "Bookman's House" scene.
- Updated loading screens.
- Fixed a bug with saving.
- Fixed a bug with starting a new game.
- Fixed a bug with the door model in the maze.
- Fixed a bug with loading the "Hospital" scene.
- Fixed bugs with the door in the "Day 1" and "Day 2" scenes.
- Fixed bugs with textures in the "Maze" scene.
